title: Signaling with debt currency choice
title_zh: 债务货币选择中的信号传递
title_primary: 债务货币选择中的信号传递
title_secondary: Signaling with debt currency choice
authors: Egemen Eren, Semyon Malamud, Haonan Zhou
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Firms often expose themselves to currency risk by borrowing in foreign currencies, even when the local currency actually provides a better hedge in downturns. Motivated by this novel fact, we develop an international corporate finance model in which firms facing adverse selection choose the foreign currency share of their debt. In the unique separating equilibrium, good firms optimally expose themselves to currency risk to signal their type. Crucially, the nature of this equilibrium depends on the co-movement between cash flows and the exchange rate. We provide evidence consistent with the predictions of the model using a granular dataset including more than 4800 firms in 19 emerging markets and 5700 firms in 22 advanced economies between 2005 and 2021. The signaling mechanism is most salient for firms in emerging markets and also those subject to greater information asymmetries in advanced economies. These findings are important for assessing and managing risks from currency mismatches on corporate balance sheets.
abstract_zh: 企业常常通过借入外币来暴露自身于汇率风险之中，即便本币在经济下行期实际上能提供更好的对冲效果。受这一新颖事实启发，我们构建了一个国际企业金融模型，在该模型中，面临逆向选择的企业会选择其债务中外币所占的比例。在唯一的分离均衡中，优质企业会最优地选择暴露于汇率风险以传递其类型信号。关键在于，这一均衡的性质取决于现金流与汇率之间的联动关系。我们利用一个包含2005年至2021年间19个新兴市场超过4800家企业及22个发达经济体5700家企业的精细数据集，提供了与模型预测相一致的证据。信号机制在新兴市场的企业中最为显著，同时也在发达经济体中面临更大信息不对称的企业中表现突出。这些发现对于评估和管理企业资产负债表上货币错配风险具有重要意义。

title: The informativeness of stock price at dual-class firms
title_zh: 双重股权结构公司股票价格的信息含量
title_primary: 双重股权结构公司股票价格的信息含量
title_secondary: The informativeness of stock price at dual-class firms
authors: Bangert, Jason, Myers, Linda A., Schmardebeck, Roy
official: 官方在线 2026-09-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We examine whether disproportionate insider control, or the divergence between insider voting and cash flow rights at dual-class firms, influences the extent to which stock price reflects information about future firm performance. We find that current returns incorporate less information about future earnings and cash flows as disproportionate insider control increases. However, monitoring by influential institutional investors, strong board oversight, and high-quality disclosure significantly attenuate this effect, such that disproportionate insider control does not result in less informative stock prices. Collectively, our findings reveal that, although the dual-class structure is associated with less informative stock prices, on average, monitoring and disclosure can alleviate investor concerns about disproportionate insider control while allowing firms to take advantage of the benefits of a dual-class ownership structure.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了双重股权结构公司中不成比例的内部人控制，即内部人投票权与现金流权之间的差异，是否影响股价反映未来公司业绩信息的程度。研究发现，随着不成比例的内部人控制增强，当前收益对未来盈利和现金流信息的包含程度降低。然而，有影响力的机构投资者监督、强有力的董事会监管以及高质量的信息披露显著削弱了这一效应，使得不成比例的内部人控制不会导致股价信息含量降低。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，尽管双重股权结构平均而言与股价信息含量较低相关，但监督和披露能够缓解投资者对不成比例内部人控制的担忧，同时使企业能够利用双重股权结构带来的优势。

title: Picking Winners: Local Land Allocation and Bottom-Up Industrial Policy in China
title_zh: 挑选赢家：中国地方土地配置与自下而上的产业政策
title_primary: 挑选赢家：中国地方土地配置与自下而上的产业政策
title_secondary: Picking Winners: Local Land Allocation and Bottom-Up Industrial Policy in China
authors: Wenjia Tian, Zhi Wang, Qinghua Zhang
abstract: This study examines the industrial preferences of local governments in China through the lens of land allocation. We analyze industrial land transactions from 2007 to 2019, a period marked by both expanding industrial policy and intensifying land market competition. Using a border discontinuity design that compares land transactions near county borders, we separate local government preferences from firm demand. We find systematic industrial favoritism: localities offer deeper price discounts to industries aligned with their existing specialization. This favoritism persists over time, is more pronounced in industries with substantial unrealized agglomeration potential, and is stronger in regions with well-developed market institutions. We further show that local governments comply with upper-level industrial policy only when it aligns with their own specialization. Together, these findings point to a bottom-up process in which local governments use land allocation to attract firms that reinforce local industrial strengths through agglomeration spillovers.
abstract_zh: 本研究从土地配置的视角考察了中国地方政府的产业偏好。我们分析了2007年至2019年间的工业用地交易，这一时期既见证了产业政策的扩张，也伴随着土地市场竞争的加剧。通过采用边界断点设计，对县域边界附近的土地交易进行比较，我们将地方政府的偏好与企业需求分离开来。研究发现存在系统性的产业偏向：地方政府对与其现有专业化方向相符的产业给予更深的土地价格折扣。这种偏向随时间持续存在，在具有显著未实现集聚潜力的产业中更为突出，并且在市场制度发达的地区表现更强。我们进一步表明，地方政府仅在上级产业政策与其自身专业化方向一致时才予以执行。综合来看，这些发现揭示了一个自下而上的过程，即地方政府通过土地配置来吸引能够通过集聚溢出效应强化本地产业优势的企业。

title: Working for a Living? Women and Children’s Labour Inputs in England, 1260-1850
title_zh: 为生计而工作？1260-1850年英格兰妇女与儿童的劳动投入
title_primary: 为生计而工作？1260-1850年英格兰妇女与儿童的劳动投入
title_secondary: Working for a Living? Women and Children’s Labour Inputs in England, 1260-1850
authors: Sara Horrell, Jane Humphries, Jacob Weisdorf
official: 官方在线 2020-04-23 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We consider the living standards, supplies of child-labour, and poor-relief needs among intact and broken working-class families of various sizes in historical England. We estimate family incomes without resort to the usual day wages and ahistorical assumptions about male labour inputs. We also incorporate women and children’s wages and labour alongside consumption smoothing using a life-cycle approach. Living standards varied considerably over time and by family structure and dependency ratio. Small and intact families enjoyed high and rising living standards after 1700. Large and broken families depended on child labour and poor relief up until 1830.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了历史英格兰时期不同规模完整与破碎工人阶级家庭的生活水平、童工供给及贫困救济需求。我们估算家庭收入时，未依赖通常的日工资及关于男性劳动投入的非历史性假设。同时，我们将妇女和儿童的工资及劳动纳入考量，并采用生命周期方法进行消费平滑。生活水平随时间、家庭结构和抚养比的不同而有显著差异。1700年后，小型且完整的家庭享有较高且不断提升的生活水平。直至1830年，大型及破碎家庭仍依赖童工和贫困救济。

title: Drought exposure and crop insurance demand: evidence from Rural China
title_zh: 干旱暴露与农作物保险需求：来自中国农村的证据
title_primary: 干旱暴露与农作物保险需求：来自中国农村的证据
title_secondary: Drought exposure and crop insurance demand: evidence from Rural China
authors: Yan Shang, Miao Li, Yifeng Guo
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-17 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Extreme weather increasingly threatens agricultural production, underscoring the need to enhance farmers’ adaptive capacity and strengthen disaster risk management. Using panel data from China’s National Fixed Observation Points (NFOP) matched with ERA5 data for 2009–2019, this study employs fixed-effects models to examine the effects of extreme weather on farmers’ agricultural insurance participation and insurance expenditure, and further analyzes the moderating role of insurance claims. We further examine how variation in the severity of extreme weather affects farmers’ crop insurance participation and coverage levels. The results show that drought exposure increases farmers’ likelihood of purchasing agricultural insurance, particularly under prolonged drought conditions. However, the effect on insurance payment levels is mixed: short-term drought shocks are associated with increased insurance investment, while moderate-duration drought shows a negative association, and intermediate horizons yield insignificant results. This heterogeneity suggests that farmers‘ coverage adjustment responses are contingent on the duration and timing of drought exposure. The association between drought exposure and insurance uptake is more pronounced among households with prior claim experience. KEYWORDS: Agricultural disasters crop insurance drought severity insurance demand JEL CLASSIFICATION: Q14 Q13 Q54
abstract_zh: 极端天气日益威胁农业生产，凸显了增强农户适应能力与强化灾害风险管理的必要性。本研究利用中国国家固定观测点（NFOP）2009—2019年的面板数据，匹配ERA5气象数据，采用固定效应模型考察极端天气对农户农业保险参与及保费支出的影响，并进一步分析保险理赔的调节作用。同时，本文还探讨了极端天气严重程度的变化如何影响农户种植业保险参与及保障水平。结果表明，干旱暴露提高了农户购买农业保险的可能性，尤其是在持续干旱条件下。然而，干旱对保险支付水平的影响呈现混合效应：短期干旱冲击与保险投入增加相关，中等时长干旱则呈负向关联，而中间时段的影响不显著。这一异质性表明，农户保障水平的调整反应取决于干旱暴露的持续时间和发生时机。干旱暴露与保险参与之间的正向关联在具有既往理赔经历的农户中更为显著。关键词：农业灾害；种植业保险；干旱严重程度；保险需求 JEL分类：Q14 Q13 Q54

title: Making organization’s cost salient: A natural field experiment
title_zh: 凸显组织成本：一项自然田野实验
title_primary: 凸显组织成本：一项自然田野实验
title_secondary: Making organization’s cost salient: A natural field experiment
authors: Fuhai Hong, Yohanes E. Riyanto, Jubo Yan, Yuanyuan Huo
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
abstract: We report findings from a natural field experiment conducted at a university in which staff members order stationery for work-related purposes online, and the university bears the entire cost. We randomize staff members into a treatment and a control group. Only the former observes the cost information in the online ordering interface. We find that displaying the organization’s cost did not change the ordering frequency, nor the quantity of requested items, conditional on the items being ordered (the intensive margin), but did reduce the variety of items ordered (the extensive margin). Overall, the intervention led to a significant reduction in stationery consumption, resulting in a 27% decrease in quantities and substantial cost savings for the university. Thus, individuals at least partially internalize the external effects of their actions when the organization’s cost is made salient.
abstract_zh: 我们报告了一项在大学进行的自然现场实验结果，该实验中，员工出于工作目的在线订购文具，而大学承担全部费用。我们将员工随机分为处理组和对照组，仅前者能在在线订购界面看到成本信息。研究发现，展示组织成本并未改变订购频率，也未改变在订购物品条件下的请求数量（集约边际），但确实减少了订购物品的种类（广延边际）。总体而言，该干预措施显著降低了文具消耗，导致数量减少27%，并为大学节省了大量成本。因此，当组织的成本变得显著时，个体至少部分地内化了其行为的外部效应。

title: Industrial Policy and Trade Tensions in Strategic Sectors
title_zh: 战略性产业的产业政策与贸易紧张局势
title_primary: 战略性产业的产业政策与贸易紧张局势
title_secondary: Industrial Policy and Trade Tensions in Strategic Sectors
authors: Lorenzo Rotunno & Michele Ruta & Priyam Verma
official: 官方在线 2026-07-24 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper examines the global trade and welfare effects of industrial subsidies, employing a multi-country, multi-sector general equilibrium trade model with economies of scale. We first estimate the magnitude of industrial subsidies across countries relying on a novel approach that exploits information on subsidy counts during the period 2015-23. We then quantify the impact of the implied subsidy rates on trade flows and find that subsidies boost net exports in strategic sectors especially for China, while causing export declines in competing economies. Subsidies by the EU and the US produce qualitatively similar but smaller effects, as these economies target relatively more non-strategic sectors. A decomposition of the trade effects highlights the role of economies of scale and productivity changes in explaining sectoral specialization in response to subsidies. Tariff actions in 2018-19 and since 2025 partly offset these trade patterns. While targeting strategic sectors, recent subsidies and import tariffs lower global welfare by creating distortions and negative cross-border externalities.
abstract_zh: 本文运用包含规模经济的多国、多部门一般均衡贸易模型，考察产业补贴对全球贸易与福利的影响。我们首先基于2015-23年期间补贴数量的新型测算方法，估算各国产业补贴规模；进而量化隐含补贴率对贸易流的影响，发现补贴显著提升了战略性部门的净出口（尤其在中国），同时导致竞争经济体的出口下降。欧盟与美国的补贴虽产生性质相似但幅度较小的效应，因其补贴对象更多集中于非战略性部门。贸易效应的分解分析表明，规模经济与生产率变化在解释补贴引发的部门专业化分工中发挥关键作用。2018-19年及2025年以来的关税措施部分抵消了上述贸易格局。近期针对战略性部门的补贴与进口关税，通过制造扭曲与负面跨境外部性，降低了全球福利水平。

title: Learning from observed matches in two-sided markets
title_zh: 从双边市场中的观测匹配中学习
title_primary: 从双边市场中的观测匹配中学习
title_secondary: Learning from observed matches in two-sided markets
authors: Suwan (Cheng) Long
abstract: This paper asks what can be learned from observed merger pairings when acquirers and targets meet in a two-sided market with transferable utility. A compact assignment-game model implies revealed-preference inequalities: observed matches must generate at least as much total surplus as feasible counterfactual matches in the same local market. I take these inequalities to Refinitiv M&A data for U.S. same-industry transactions during 2010–2024. The final estimation sample contains 1025 completed acquirer-target pairs and 36,881 financially feasible counterfactual pairs constructed within industry-quarter cells. A benchmark linear surplus specification based on differences in profitability, leverage, sales growth, and liquidity has weak identifying content. Across 60 optimization runs, the same maximum score is obtained, but the coefficient vectors attaining it differ substantially in sign and magnitude. The result is not a general impossibility claim about revealed-preference methods. It shows that observed matches and standard financial differences alone provide limited discipline on merger surplus when transfers, outside options, and richer pair-specific synergies are unobserved.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨在具有可转移效用的双边市场中，当收购方与目标方相遇时，从观察到的并购配对中能获得何种信息。一个紧凑的指派博弈模型揭示了显示性偏好不等式：观察到的配对必须至少产生与同一局部市场中可行的反事实配对相等的总剩余。我将这些不等式应用于2010-2024年美国同行业交易的Refinitiv并购数据。最终估计样本包含1025个已完成的收购方-目标方配对，以及在行业-季度单元内构建的36881个财务上可行的反事实配对。基于盈利能力、杠杆率、销售增长率和流动性差异的基准线性剩余设定，其识别能力较弱。在60次优化运行中，虽获得相同的最大得分，但达到该得分的系数向量在符号和大小上存在显著差异。这一结果并非对显示性偏好方法的普遍不可行性论断。它表明，当转移支付、外部选择以及更丰富的配对特定协同效应未被观测到时，仅凭观察到的配对和标准财务差异对并购剩余的约束作用有限。

title: DP767 Time-inconsistency, Democracy and Optimal Contingent Rules
title_zh: 时间不一致性、民主与最优应急规则
title_primary: 时间不一致性、民主与最优应急规则
title_secondary: DP767 Time-inconsistency, Democracy and Optimal Contingent Rules
authors: Patrick Minford, Mario Francesco Carillo, Francesco Fasani, Simone Ferro, Alessio Romarri 等
official: 官方在线 1993-02-28 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper sets out a model of democratic elections in which floating voters may find it optimal to follow this strategy. The significance of this possibility is that regimes which permit contingent macroeconomic policy responses, while enabling prior targets to be set and policed, are superior to those which do not. This has relevance to the debate over the Exchange Rate Mechanism and the European Monetary Union.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个民主选举模型，其中浮动选民可能发现遵循这一策略是最优选择。这一可能性的重要意义在于，允许相机抉择的宏观经济政策回应、同时能够设定并监督事前目标的制度安排，优于不具备这些特征的制度。这一结论对有关汇率机制与欧洲货币联盟的辩论具有参考价值。

title: DP521 Spain's Industrial Exports to the EEC: A Panel Data Approach
title_zh: 西班牙对欧共体的工业出口：面板数据分析
title_primary: 西班牙对欧共体的工业出口：面板数据分析
title_secondary: DP521 Spain's Industrial Exports to the EEC: A Panel Data Approach
authors: Carmela Martín, Lourdes Moreno, Dino Pinelli, Keith Head, Thierry Mayer 等
official: 官方在线 1991-04-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper investigates the determinants of trends in Spain's industrial exports to other Community countries by using a sectoral panel data approach. Apart from overcoming the bias likely to arise from aggregate trade equations, this procedure is useful in detecting the existence of individual (sectoral) effects which, according to new Industrial Organization Trade models, seem to be crucial in explaining industrial trade patterns. Our results show that both cost and price elasticities of export demand differ widely among sectors. Additionally, they support the hypothesis about the significant influence of advertising expenditure and, to a lesser extent, technological effort on Spain's industrial export performance.
abstract_zh: 本文采用部门面板数据方法，探究西班牙对其他共同体国家工业出口趋势的决定因素。该方法不仅能够克服加总贸易方程可能产生的偏误，还有助于识别个体（部门）效应的存在——根据新产业组织贸易模型，这些效应对解释工业贸易模式至关重要。研究结果表明，各行业的出口需求成本弹性与价格弹性存在显著差异。此外，实证结果支持了广告支出对西班牙工业出口绩效具有显著影响的假设，而技术投入的影响程度相对较小。

title: Condiciones y riesgos de trabajo en el reparto mediado por plataformas en Argentina
title_zh: 阿根廷平台配送工作中的劳动条件与风险
title_primary: 阿根廷平台配送工作中的劳动条件与风险
title_secondary: Condiciones y riesgos de trabajo en el reparto mediado por plataformas en Argentina
authors: Cutuli, Romina, Pellegrini, Mariana, Savino, Julia Victoria
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Los objetivos del trabajo son reconstruir los discursos sociales sobre los riesgos del trabajo de reparto mediado por plataformas a partir de la prensa digital escrita; y recuperar las preocupaciones y experiencias en relación con los riesgos del trabajo de reparto mediado por plataformas a partir del relato de los trabajadores del sector en el Área Metropolitana de Buenos Aires (AMBA).
abstract_zh: 本文旨在基于数字书面媒体，重构平台中介配送工作中关于风险的社会话语；同时，通过布宜诺斯艾利斯大都市区（AMBA）该行业从业者的叙述，梳理与平台中介配送工作风险相关的关切与经验。

title: Repression and Autocratic Consolidation
title_zh: 压制与威权巩固
title_primary: 压制与威权巩固
title_secondary: Repression and Autocratic Consolidation
authors: Livio Di Lonardo, Jessica S. Sun, Scott A. Tyson
abstract: We develop a dynamic model of autocracy in which repression helps quell acute threats, increasing an autocrat’s survival probability or deterring challenges altogether, but at the expense of policies that reduce popular discontent and future opposition mobilization. Our main contribution is characterizing a unique stationary Markov Perfect equilibrium, which takes one of three forms: deterrence, where the autocrat is never challenged; instability, where challenges occur every period; or a deterrence/contention mixed-strategy equilibrium with periods of deterrence and periods with challenges. The mixed-strategy equilibrium arises because the opposition is easier to deter today when they expect opportunities to challenge in the future. We then examine indirect foreign interference–such as sanctions or withholding aid–aimed at protecting the opposition or promoting democratization. Even under ideal conditions, such interference cannot achieve both goals simultaneously.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个专制政权的动态模型，其中镇压有助于平息严重威胁，提高独裁者的生存概率或完全阻止挑战，但代价是采取减少民众不满和未来反对派动员的政策。我们的主要贡献在于刻画了一个独特的平稳马尔可夫完美均衡，该均衡呈现三种形式之一：威慑，即独裁者从未受到挑战；不稳定，即每个时期都发生挑战；或威慑/抗争混合策略均衡，其中存在威慑期和挑战期。混合策略均衡之所以出现，是因为当反对派预期未来有机会发起挑战时，他们今天更容易被威慑。随后，我们考察了旨在保护反对派或促进民主化的间接外国干预——如制裁或暂停援助。即使在理想条件下，此类干预也无法同时实现这两个目标。

title: Residential Segregation and Unequal Access to Local Public Services in India: Evidence from 1.5 Million Neighborhoods
title_zh: 印度居住隔离与地方公共服务获取不平等：来自150万邻里的证据
title_primary: 印度居住隔离与地方公共服务获取不平等：来自150万邻里的证据
title_secondary: Residential Segregation and Unequal Access to Local Public Services in India: Evidence from 1.5 Million Neighborhoods
authors: Asher, Sam, Jha, Kritarth, Novosad, Paul, Adukia, Anjali, Tan, Brandon
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: We study residential segregation and access to public services across 1.5 million urban and rural neighborhoods in India. Muslim and Scheduled Caste segregation in India is high by global standards, and only slightly lower than Black-White segregation in the United States. Within cities, public facilities and infrastructure are systematically less available in Muslim and Scheduled Caste neighborhoods. Nearly all regressive allocation is across neighborhoods within cities—at the most informal and least studied form of government. These inequalities are not visible in the aggregate data typically used for research and policy.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了印度150万个城乡社区中的居住隔离与公共服务获取情况。按全球标准衡量，印度穆斯林与表列种姓的居住隔离程度较高，仅略低于美国的黑白种族隔离。在城市内部，穆斯林与表列种姓社区的公共设施和基础设施系统性匮乏。几乎所有倒退性资源分配都发生在城市内部的社区之间——这属于最非正式且研究最少的政府层级。这些不平等现象在通常用于研究与政策制定的汇总数据中无法显现。

title: Running against windmills: Costly perseverance in long- and short-term goal pursuit
title_zh: 逆风而行：长期与短期目标追求中的高成本坚持
title_primary: 逆风而行：长期与短期目标追求中的高成本坚持
title_secondary: Running against windmills: Costly perseverance in long- and short-term goal pursuit
authors: Anna L.M. Daelen
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-30 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper provides evidence of costly perseverance in the field. In a setting where consultants select and pursue projects autonomously, I show that perseverance, conditional on consistency of interest, is associated with fewer successfully completed projects as well as lower sales and commissions. Using rich firm data on individual job activity, I shed light on the task-specific behavioral mechanisms. Overall, perseverant consultants start fewer projects. In fast markets, the lower number of projects started is the main channel of costly perseverance; in slower markets, costs primarily arise from pursuing projects in a more isolated and uninformed way, as shown by an inefficient allocation of effort between stakeholders. The survey questions driving costly perseverance point to the consultants’ failure to incorporate negative signals and opportunity costs into their effort allocation. Using heterogeneity within and between consultants’ task assignment, I show that perseverance is more costly in exploration tasks as opposed to well-defined tasks characterized by mere exploitation.
abstract_zh: 本文提供了关于“昂贵坚持”在实地环境中的证据。在一个顾问自主选择并追求项目的环境中，我表明，在兴趣一致性条件下，坚持与成功完成项目数量减少以及销售额和佣金降低相关。利用关于个体工作活动的丰富企业数据，我揭示了任务特定行为机制。总体而言，坚持的顾问启动的项目较少。在快速市场中，启动项目数量减少是昂贵坚持的主要渠道；在较慢市场中，成本主要源于以更孤立且信息不足的方式追求项目，这体现在利益相关者之间努力分配的低效上。驱动昂贵坚持的调查问题指向顾问未能将负面信号和机会成本纳入其努力分配中。利用顾问任务分配内部及之间的异质性，我表明，坚持在探索性任务中比在仅需利用的明确任务中成本更高。

title: Securities transaction settlement optimization on superconducting quantum devices
title_zh: 超导量子设备上的证券交易结算优化
title_primary: 超导量子设备上的证券交易结算优化
title_secondary: Securities transaction settlement optimization on superconducting quantum devices
authors: Francesco Martini, Daniele Lizzio Bosco, Carlo Barbanera, Serena Bernardini, Giacomo Ranieri 等
source: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-29 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We describe a quantum variational algorithm for securities transactions settlement optimization, based on a novel mathematical formalization of the problem that includes the most relevant constraints considered in the pan-European securities settlement platform TARGET2-Securities. The proposed algorithm is designed for Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum devices, specifically targeting IBM's superconducting qubit machines. We adopt non-linear activation functions to encode inequality constraints in the objective function of the problem, and design customized noise mitigation techniques to alleviate the effect of readout errors. We consider batches of up to 40 trades obtained from real transactional data to benchmark our algorithm on quantum hardware against classical and quantum-inspired solvers.
abstract_zh: 我们描述了一种用于证券交易结算优化的量子变分算法，该算法基于问题的一种新颖数学形式化，包含了泛欧证券结算平台TARGET2-Securities中考虑的最相关约束条件。所提出的算法专为噪声中等规模量子设备设计，特别针对IBM的超导量子比特机器。我们采用非线性激活函数将不等式约束编码到问题的目标函数中，并设计定制化的噪声缓解技术以减轻读出误差的影响。我们利用从真实交易数据中获取的至多40笔交易的批次，在量子硬件上对我们的算法与经典及量子启发式求解器进行了基准测试。

title: Corporate social responsibility as sustainable financial strategy: Evidence from China's targeted poverty alleviation
title_zh: 企业社会责任作为可持续财务战略：来自中国精准扶贫的证据
title_primary: 企业社会责任作为可持续财务战略：来自中国精准扶贫的证据
title_secondary: Corporate social responsibility as sustainable financial strategy: Evidence from China's targeted poverty alleviation
authors: Jia Meng, ZhongXiang Zhang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-25 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Long-standing tensions exist for firms in developing economies between fulfilling social responsibility mandates and securing sustainable growth. This study leverages China's Targeted Poverty Alleviation (TPA) initiative to demonstrate that corporate participation in poverty reduction serves as a strategic and sustainable investment, simultaneously advancing societal development and providing financing support. Specifically, we find that TPA participation significantly reduces firms' financing costs, an effect that is amplified by greater TPA investment intensity and assistance difficulty. Particularly for firms with limited political connections, TPA financing benefits are boosted through social responsibility credit substituting for traditional political capital. Moreover, balanced equity configurations significantly intensify these cost-reduction effects. Mechanistically, by responding to state-led institutional pressures, firms secure political resources such as fiscal subsidies and tax relief that further ease financing burdens. Meanwhile, TPA reduces information asymmetries and elevates corporate social governance ratings, thereby enhancing creditworthiness and access to credit from banks and suppliers. Motivation analyses confirm that TPA engagement stems from a strategic objective rather than an attempt to conceal corporate misconduct. Overall, our findings illuminate a transformative pathway for emerging markets: converting national institutional pressures into strategic leverage allows firms to achieve both societal objectives and long-term financial resilience.
abstract_zh: 发展中经济体的企业在履行社会责任与确保可持续增长之间长期存在张力。本研究利用中国精准扶贫（TPA）倡议，证明企业参与减贫是一种战略性和可持续的投资，同时推动社会发展并提供融资支持。具体而言，我们发现TPA参与显著降低了企业的融资成本，且这一效应因更高的TPA投资强度和帮扶难度而增强。尤其对于政治关联有限的企业，TPA融资收益通过社会责任信用替代传统政治资本而得到提升。此外，均衡的股权配置显著强化了这些降成本效应。在机制上，通过响应国家主导的制度压力，企业获得财政补贴和税收减免等政治资源，进一步缓解融资负担。同时，TPA降低了信息不对称并提升了企业社会治理论评级，从而增强信用度及从银行和供应商获取信贷的渠道。动机分析证实，TPA参与源于战略目标而非掩盖企业不当行为的企图。总体而言，我们的发现揭示了新兴市场的一条转型路径：将国家制度压力转化为战略杠杆，使企业能够同时实现社会目标与长期财务韧性。

title: Refineries, Pipelines and Petroleum Fields - The Impact of Oil on Conflict Around the World
title_zh: 炼油厂、管道与油田——石油对全球冲突的影响
title_primary: 炼油厂、管道与油田——石油对全球冲突的影响
title_secondary: Refineries, Pipelines and Petroleum Fields - The Impact of Oil on Conflict Around the World
authors: Axel Dreher, Maximilian Herrmann, Jingke Pan
official: 官方在线 2026-06-21 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study how global oil price shocks affect the spatial distribution of violent conflict. Combining monthly georeferenced data on oil infrastructure with conflict events worldwide over 1989-2021, we exploit exogenous variation in world crude oil prices within countries using grid-cell and country*month fixed effects. Oil price increases raise organized conflict in oil-bearing cells but reduce it in nearby non-oil areas, indicating a spatial reallocation of territorial violence toward economically valuable locations rather than a uniform increase in conflict. By contrast, lower-intensity unrest spreads across neighboring cells, consistent with diffuse grievance and mobilization channels. The effect is strongest for petroleum fields and driven by state-based conflict, consistent with intensified contestation over oil rents, while downstream infrastructure is associated with protests and localized violence. The magnitude of the response varies with ethnic exclusion, institutions, geography, and ownership, pointing to rent-contestation mechanisms shaped by local conditions.
abstract_zh: 本文研究全球油价冲击如何影响暴力冲突的空间分布。结合1989-2021年间全球石油基础设施的月度地理参考数据与冲突事件，我们利用国家内网格单元和国家*月份的固定效应，捕捉世界原油价格的外生变化。油价上涨会加剧含油网格中的有组织冲突，但减少附近非油区域的冲突，表明领土暴力向经济价值更高的地点发生空间再分配，而非冲突的普遍增加。相比之下，强度较低的骚乱会扩散至邻近网格单元，这与广泛的怨恨情绪和动员渠道机制一致。该效应在油田区域最为显著，且主要由国家间冲突驱动，符合围绕石油租金的争夺加剧现象；而下游基础设施则与抗议和局部暴力相关。响应强度因族群排斥、制度、地理和所有权而异，表明租金争夺机制受地方条件塑造。

title: Policy Catering or Market Choice: Industrial Policy Consistency and Firm Exports
title_zh: 政策迎合还是市场选择：产业政策一致性与企业出口
title_primary: 政策迎合还是市场选择：产业政策一致性与企业出口
title_secondary: Policy Catering or Market Choice: Industrial Policy Consistency and Firm Exports
authors: Yuping Deng, Jinxiao Yang, Cenjie Liu, Rui Xie
abstract: During China's transformation from a quantity‐oriented to a quality‐oriented trading nation, industrial policy consistency (IPC) between central and local governments has been an important driving force for firm exports. We investigate this IPC by extracting information on the preferential industries mentioned in the Chinese 10th to 12th Five‐Year Plans (FYPs) and empirically analyze the relationship between IPC and firm exports on the basis of Chinese firm‐level data from 2001 to 2015. The results indicate that IPC expands the firms' export scales but reduces the quality of products exported. This phenomenon is driven primarily by increasing subsidy reliance, intensifying excessive market competition and weakening innovation incentives. The heterogeneity analysis indicates that IPC has a more profound effect on the export outcomes of state‐owned enterprises, large firms, pillar industries and regions facing high levels of official promotion pressure. We further find that comparative advantages can relatively mitigate the decline in quality caused by policy consistency. Our findings have important policy implications for coordinating regional industrial policies and improving export competitiveness.
abstract_zh: 在中国从数量导向型贸易大国向质量导向型贸易大国转型过程中，中央与地方政府间的产业政策一致性（IPC）已成为推动企业出口的重要驱动力。本文通过提取中国第十至第十二个五年规划中提及的优先发展产业信息，基于2001-2015年中国企业层面数据，实证分析了产业政策一致性与企业出口之间的关系。研究结果表明，产业政策一致性扩大了企业出口规模，但降低了出口产品质量。这一现象主要源于补贴依赖度上升、过度市场竞争加剧以及创新激励弱化。异质性分析显示，产业政策一致性对国有企业、大型企业、支柱产业以及面临较高官员晋升压力地区的出口表现影响更为显著。进一步研究发现，比较优势能够相对缓解政策一致性导致的质量下降。本研究对协调区域产业政策、提升出口竞争力具有重要政策启示。

title: Factor‐Based Quantile Forecasting With Textual Data
title_zh: 基于文本数据的因子分位数预测
title_primary: 基于文本数据的因子分位数预测
title_secondary: Factor‐Based Quantile Forecasting With Textual Data
authors: Jie Wei, Luiz Renato Lima, Lucas Lúcio Godeiro
abstract: ABSTRACT Words matter for predicting tail risks. We propose an attention mechanism embedded in a quantile factor model, yielding information that is quantile‐specific, target‐specific, and horizon‐specific. We establish new asymptotic results and show empirically that targeted textual data improve quantile forecasts of exchange‐rate returns and industrial production growth relative to strong benchmarks and other conditional‐quantile models. Bigrams and trigrams drive these gains, extending evidence that collocations enhance forecasting. A portfolio‐management application yields better allocations and higher risk‐adjusted performance. Robustness checks include a synthetic‐misinformation stress test, which shows that fabricated news does not create spurious predictability. Results are consistent across targets, horizons, and both rolling and recursive schemes.
abstract_zh: 词汇对于预测尾部风险至关重要。我们提出了一种嵌入分位数因子模型中的注意力机制，该机制能够生成针对特定分位数、特定目标及特定时间跨度的信息。我们建立了新的渐近结果，并实证表明，相较于强基准模型及其他条件分位数模型，针对性的文本数据能显著提升汇率收益率和工业生产增长的预测精度。二元词组和三元词组是这些改进的主要驱动力，进一步证实了搭配词能够增强预测能力的观点。一项投资组合管理应用实现了更优的资产配置和更高的风险调整后绩效。稳健性检验包括一项合成错误信息压力测试，该测试表明，虚构新闻不会产生虚假的可预测性。结果在目标、时间跨度以及滚动和递归方案中均保持一致。

title: Endogenous volatility and strategic disclosure in mutual funds
title_zh: 共同基金的内生波动性与策略性披露
title_primary: 共同基金的内生波动性与策略性披露
title_secondary: Endogenous volatility and strategic disclosure in mutual funds
authors: Zhongjie Fan
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We develop an information design model where mutual fund managers jointly choose portfolio volatility and disclosure policy to maximize fee revenue from risk-averse investors. We demonstrate that persuasion fundamentally drives risk-taking. When high risk-free rates render funds unappealing, managers endogenously inflate asset volatility to manufacture the information asymmetry required to persuade investors. Optimal volatility strictly increases with the risk-free rate and decreases with investor risk aversion. Our framework highlights how high interest rates inadvertently incentivize excessive risk-taking in asset management.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个信息设计模型，其中共同基金经理联合选择投资组合波动性和披露政策，以最大化来自风险厌恶投资者的费用收入。我们证明，说服机制从根本上驱动了风险承担行为。当高无风险利率使基金缺乏吸引力时，经理人内生地抬高资产波动性，以制造说服投资者所需的信息不对称。最优波动性随无风险利率严格递增，随投资者风险厌恶程度递减。我们的框架揭示了高利率如何无意中激励资产管理中的过度风险承担。

title: Generative AI: Catalyst for Growth or Harbinger of Premature De‐Professionalization?
title_zh: 生成式人工智能：增长催化剂还是过早去职业化的预兆？
title_primary: 生成式人工智能：增长催化剂还是过早去职业化的预兆？
title_secondary: Generative AI: Catalyst for Growth or Harbinger of Premature De‐Professionalization?
authors: Yan Liu
abstract: This paper develops a multi-sector growth model to analyse the general equilibrium effects of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) on growth, structural transformation and international trade. It introduces a crucial distinction between high-skill, high-income, highly digitalized, tradable services and low-skill, less digitalized, less-tradable services, allowing GenAI to differentially affect sectors through both supply-side productivity gains and demand-side shifts in consumer preferences. The model generates testable implications consistent with emerging empirical evidence and delivers several novel predictions. Unless GenAI adoption is broad-based and accompanied by the creation of new products that shift demand toward skill-intensive activities, its aggregate growth effects are likely to be modest. The paper highlights the risk of ‘premature de-professionalization’—a contraction in the capacity of economies, particularly developing ones, to generate well-paid jobs in high-skill services. This process is primarily driven by domestic general equilibrium forces, as productivity gains in high-skill sectors may outpace demand expansion and reduce labour absorption. International trade plays a critical amplifying role in shaping both the timing and severity of this process: falling global relative prices of high-skill tradable services, combined with delayed AI adoption, can erode comparative advantage and lock countries into low-skill, low-income specializations. In this respect, premature de-professionalization parallels the well-documented phenomenon of premature de-industrialization, but operates through high-skill services rather than manufacturing—potentially narrowing development pathways at earlier stages of income.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个多部门增长模型，用以分析生成式人工智能（GenAI）对经济增长、结构转型及国际贸易的总体均衡效应。模型引入了高技能、高收入、高度数字化且可贸易的服务业与低技能、数字化程度较低且可贸易性较弱的服务业之间的关键区分，从而使GenAI能够通过供给侧生产率提升和需求侧消费者偏好转变，对各部门产生差异化影响。该模型得出的可检验推论与新兴经验证据相符，并提出了若干新颖预测。除非GenAI的采用具有广泛基础，并伴随新产品创造以将需求转向技能密集型活动，否则其总体增长效应可能较为有限。本文强调了“过早去职业化”的风险——即经济体（尤其是发展中经济体）在高技能服务业中创造高薪岗位能力的收缩。这一过程主要由国内总体均衡力量驱动，因为高技能部门的生产率提升可能超过需求扩张，从而减少劳动力吸纳。国际贸易在塑造这一过程的时间与严重程度方面发挥着关键的放大作用：全球高技能可贸易服务相对价格下降，加之AI采用滞后，可能侵蚀比较优势，并将国家锁定在低技能、低收入的专业化分工中。就此而言，过早去职业化与广为人知的过早去工业化现象相似，但其作用渠道是高技能服务业而非制造业——这可能在更早的收入阶段就收窄了发展路径。

title: Labor Market Monopsony Power and the Dynamic Gains to Openness Reforms
title_zh: 劳动力市场买方垄断势力与开放改革的动态收益
title_primary: 劳动力市场买方垄断势力与开放改革的动态收益
title_secondary: Labor Market Monopsony Power and the Dynamic Gains to Openness Reforms
authors: Priyaranjan Jha, Antonio Rodriguez‐Lopez, Adam Hal Spencer
abstract: We embed labor market monopsony into a dynamic heterogeneous-firm general equilibrium model with exporting, horizontal FDI, and rich firm lifecycle dynamics. Rising marginal costs with monopsony slow and limit incumbent firm growth in response to liberalization, shifting adjustment to the extensive margin. Calibrated to US micro data, welfare gains from tariff reduction are over four times larger under monopsony than with perfect labor markets. The difference is mostly driven by new exporter creation and firm entry along the transition path. By contrast, lowering outward FDI taxes gives powerful quantitative welfare losses under monopsony, as firms undertake FDI to escape domestic wage pressure.
abstract_zh: 我们将劳动力市场买方垄断嵌入一个包含出口、水平型外商直接投资及丰富企业生命周期动态的异质性企业一般均衡模型中。买方垄断下边际成本的上升减缓并限制了在位企业应对自由化的增长，将调整转向广延边际。以美国微观数据校准后，买方垄断情形下关税削减带来的福利收益是劳动力市场完全竞争情形下的四倍以上。这一差异主要源于转型路径上新出口商的创建与企业进入。相比之下，在买方垄断下降低对外直接投资税则带来显著的量化福利损失，因为企业通过对外直接投资以规避国内工资压力。

title: Guarantees of origin and competition in the spot electricity market
title_zh: 现货电力市场中的原产地保证与竞争
title_primary: 现货电力市场中的原产地保证与竞争
title_secondary: Guarantees of origin and competition in the spot electricity market
authors: Mario Blázquez, Isabel Hovdahl, Malin Arve, Endre Bjørndal, Mette Bjørndal
abstract: We study the effect of introducing a market for green energy attributes on the market for the energy itself. In Europe, renewable energy producers receive Guarantees of Origin (GOs) that they can sell to consumers who wish to declare their electricity consumption as “green”. We introduce GOs in a model of the spot electricity market with price competition and capacity constraints. As GOs are issued only for dispatched electricity, we find that the GO market has a pro-competitive effect on the spot electricity market, leading to reduced electricity prices. Importantly, this pro-competitive effect disappears if the GO market were to be restricted by the transmission capacity in the spot market.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了引入绿色能源属性市场对能源市场本身的影响。在欧洲，可再生能源生产商获得原产地保证（GOs），可将其出售给希望宣称其电力消费为“绿色”的消费者。我们在一个包含价格竞争和容量约束的现货电力市场模型中引入GOs。由于GOs仅针对已调度电力发放，我们发现GO市场对现货电力市场具有促进竞争的作用，导致电价下降。重要的是，如果GO市场因现货市场中的输电容量限制而受到约束，这种促进竞争的效果将消失。

title: Cyclical Inequality in the Cost of Living and Implications for Monetary Policy
title_zh: 生活成本的周期性不平等及其对货币政策的影响
title_primary: 生活成本的周期性不平等及其对货币政策的影响
title_secondary: Cyclical Inequality in the Cost of Living and Implications for Monetary Policy
authors: Ting Lan, Lerong Li, Minghao Li
abstract: This paper documents that households with higher marginal propensities to consume (MPCs) consume goods with more flexible prices. Consequently, they face more cyclical and volatile inflation, and experience higher inflation following expansionary monetary policy shocks. We embed this MPC-price stickiness relationship into a tractable multi-sector two-agent New Keynesian (TANK) model and show that it dampens monetary policy effectiveness by about 15% relative to a homogeneous-basket benchmark. Introducing heterogeneous consumption baskets also generates an inefficient flexible-price equilibrium, leading to a novel trade-off between stabilization and redistribution, which alters the optimal monetary policy prescription.
abstract_zh: 本文档记录了边际消费倾向（MPCs）较高的家庭消费价格更为灵活的商品。因此，他们面临更具周期性和波动性的通胀，并在扩张性货币政策冲击后经历更高的通胀。我们将这种MPC-价格粘性关系嵌入一个易于处理的多部门双主体新凯恩斯（TANK）模型中，并表明相对于同质篮子基准，这使货币政策有效性减弱了约15%。引入异质性消费篮子还产生了低效的灵活价格均衡，导致稳定与再分配之间出现新的权衡，从而改变了最优货币政策处方。

title: Wildfires and agricultural worker injury
title_zh: 野火与农业工人伤害
title_primary: 野火与农业工人伤害
title_secondary: Wildfires and agricultural worker injury
authors: Goeun Lee, Timothy Beatty
abstract: This paper studies the impact of wildfire smoke on workplace injuries among agricultural workers, using workers' compensation claims between 2007 and 2020. We find a substantial increase in agricultural-worker injuries attributable to smoke-induced PM2.5 and wildfire smoke. Specifically, a 10 μg/m3 increase in daily PM2.5 exposure from wildfire smoke increases traumatic injuries by 2.9% and respiratory and cardiovascular injuries by 18.97%. We examine nonlinearities in the dose–response relationship and find that the health impacts of PM2.5 vary across concentration levels. The effects of smoke on traumatic injuries are largest among the oldest workers (aged 60 and above) and the youngest workers (under 30), relative to those in middle age. We find that injuries occur even at levels of PM2.5 deemed safe under current regulations. Our back-of-the-envelope calculation suggests that in 2020 alone, wildfire smoke was responsible for approximately 244 additional agricultural worker injuries in California compared to a hypothetical scenario without smoke.
abstract_zh: 本文利用2007年至2020年间的工人赔偿索赔数据，研究了野火烟雾对农业工人工作场所伤害的影响。我们发现，由烟雾引起的PM2.5及野火烟雾显著增加了农业工人的伤害数量。具体而言，每日PM2.5暴露量每增加10微克/立方米，因野火烟雾导致的创伤性伤害增加2.9%，呼吸系统和心血管伤害增加18.97%。我们考察了剂量-反应关系中的非线性特征，发现PM2.5的健康影响在不同浓度水平上存在差异。烟雾对创伤性伤害的影响在年龄最大（60岁及以上）和年龄最小（30岁以下）的工人中最为显著，相较于中年工人。我们还发现，即使在现行法规认为安全的PM2.5水平下，伤害也会发生。我们的粗略估算表明，仅2020年一年，与无烟雾的假设情景相比，野火烟雾在加利福尼亚州导致了约244起额外的农业工人伤害。

title: Field‐level crop choice responses to weather‐induced yield shocks in the US Corn Belt
title_zh: 美国玉米带田间作物选择对天气引起的产量冲击的响应
title_primary: 美国玉米带田间作物选择对天气引起的产量冲击的响应
title_secondary: Field‐level crop choice responses to weather‐induced yield shocks in the US Corn Belt
authors: Seunghyun Lee
abstract: As climate change increases the frequency and severity of extreme heat events, farmers are expected to face greater variability in crop yields. Using 10 million field-level observations, this study examines how farmers in the US Corn Belt adjust corn–soybean rotation decisions in response to yield shocks largely driven by weather fluctuations. The findings suggest that farmers tend to shift toward soybeans, which are more heat-tolerant than corn, after a hotter-than-normal growing season, regardless of which crop experienced greater yield loss. However, I find little evidence of effective adaptation: years in which farmers plant more soybeans are not, on average, hotter than usual. Moreover, shocks that occurred more than 1 year prior have substantially smaller effects than the most recent shock. This pattern is consistent with recency bias, whereby farmers place disproportionate weight on recent experiences when making decisions. Overall, the results suggest that short-term weather shocks can have lingering effects on land-use decisions in commercial agricultural systems, with important implications for both agricultural production and environmental outcomes such as water quality.
abstract_zh: 随着气候变化加剧极端高温事件的频率和严重性，农民预计将面临更大的作物产量波动。本研究利用1000万条田间观测数据，考察了美国玉米带农民如何应对主要由天气波动引起的产量冲击，调整玉米-大豆轮作决策。研究发现，在经历比正常更热的生长季节后，农民倾向于转向种植比玉米更耐热的大豆，无论哪种作物遭受了更大的产量损失。然而，几乎没有证据表明存在有效的适应行为：农民增加大豆种植的年份，平均而言并不比往常更热。此外，超过一年前发生的冲击对决策的影响远小于最近一次冲击。这一模式与近因偏差一致，即农民在决策时对近期经历赋予过重的权重。总体而言，研究结果表明，短期天气冲击可能对商业化农业系统中的土地利用决策产生持久影响，对农业生产和水质等环境结果具有重要意义。

title: Can digital finance improve corporate performance? Evidence from China
title_zh: 数字金融能否提升企业绩效？来自中国的证据
title_primary: 数字金融能否提升企业绩效？来自中国的证据
title_secondary: Can digital finance improve corporate performance? Evidence from China
authors: Shun Fu, Yu Jiang
abstract: This paper applies panel data of listed companies in China between 2011 and 2021, combined with city-level digital finance indices, to examine the impact of regional digital finance development on local corporate performance. The results clearly indicate that regional digital finance development significantly enhances local corporate performance. Specifically, digital finance mitigates financial constraints, increases the proportion of liquid assets and curtails earnings management, thereby further increasing corporate performance. This promotional effect is particularly pronounced among small and micro-sized companies, non-state-owned enterprise, and companies with weak bank-corporate relationships. This study supplements research on the economic consequences of digital finance development and the influencing factors of company performance, providing a theoretical basis and empirical evidence for the high-quality development of the real economy facilitated by digital finance advancements.
abstract_zh: 本文利用2011年至2021年中国上市公司面板数据，结合城市级数字金融指数，考察了区域数字金融发展对当地企业绩效的影响。结果明确显示，区域数字金融发展显著提升了当地企业绩效。具体而言，数字金融缓解了融资约束，增加了流动资产比例并抑制了盈余管理，从而进一步提升了企业绩效。这一促进作用在小型微型企业、非国有企业以及与银行关系较弱的企业中尤为显著。本研究补充了关于数字金融发展的经济后果及企业绩效影响因素的研究，为数字金融发展促进实体经济高质量发展提供了理论依据和实证证据。

title: Large Bayesian matrix autoregressions
title_zh: 大型贝叶斯矩阵自回归模型
title_primary: 大型贝叶斯矩阵自回归模型
title_secondary: Large Bayesian matrix autoregressions
authors: Joshua C.C. Chan, Yaling Qi
abstract: High-dimensional matrix-valued time-series are increasingly common in economics and finance. Prominent examples include large cross-region panels and dynamic economic networks. As the dimensions of the matrix grow, conventional approaches based on vector autoregressions—implemented by vectoring the matrix-valued data—become computationally infeasible. We introduce a class of large Bayesian matrix autoregressions (BMARs) that can accommodate time-varying volatility, non-Gaussian errors and COVID-19 outliers. To tackle parameter proliferation, we propose Minnesota-type shrinkage priors on the MAR coefficients. We develop a unified approach for estimating this class of models, which scales well to high dimensions. The empirical relevance of these new BMARs is illustrated using a US state-level dataset that contains 6 macroeconomic times-series for each of the 50 states, with a total of 300 times-series.
abstract_zh: 高维矩阵值时间序列在经济学和金融领域日益普遍。典型例子包括大规模跨区域面板数据和动态经济网络。随着矩阵维度的增长，基于向量自回归的传统方法——通过将矩阵值数据向量化实现——在计算上变得不可行。我们引入了一类大规模贝叶斯矩阵自回归模型（BMARs），该模型能够适应时变波动性、非高斯误差以及COVID-19异常值。为应对参数激增问题，我们提出了针对MAR系数的明尼苏达型收缩先验。我们开发了一种统一的方法来估计这类模型，该方法能良好地扩展到高维情形。通过一个包含美国各州层面数据集的实证研究，我们展示了这些新型BMARs的实际应用价值，该数据集涵盖50个州各6个宏观经济时间序列，总计300个时间序列。
